rule.contiguous_intervals: If the next signal interval begins on the immediately following cash trading day, position turnover at the boundary is abs(new_position - old_position). Same-sign continuation has zero boundary cost; reversal has two one-way costs.
rule.gap_intervals: If the next signal interval is not contiguous because of roll-risk exclusion or missing eligibility, the prior interval is forced flat at its exit and the next later interval starts from flat.
rule.final_interval: Ends flat and pays one exit-side cost.
